summary.en: Conan and the Detective Boys are visiting a group of university students who are members of the figure club. However, one of the students, Kazuya Shiraishi, is not happy with their visit, because they have a project that needs to be finished tomorrow. While Kazuya is working alone in the room, an explosion was heard and a blackout occurs. Conan tries to approach the room, but Naoto Mizuhara prevents him from going. A second explosion then occurs, and smoke is seen from the room. The door is locked, and Keiji Aoki asks Conan to call the fire department.

suspects: Naoto Mizuhara, Keiji Aoki, and Saki Midoriyama
